purpose: Blind selection of the training schedule. The holdout band is never read by the selection script (tune_report2.py opens only the four training bands).

gate.criterion: MAE of barrier error over the four TRAINING bands
gate.rationale: a model that cannot reproduce the barriers of the data it was trained on cannot serve as a representability ceiling

outcome.at_200_epochs: no configuration passed the gate (best tC, MAE 31.56 meV)
outcome.at_4000_epochs: tD passed (MAE 5.39 meV) and tE passed (5.87 meV)
outcome.selected: tD hyperparameters, i.e. the same energy/force weights and learning rate as tC; selection among gate-passing configurations used validation force RMSE (12.08 vs 20.13 meV/A), an out-of-sample quantity
outcome.consequence: the ladders were trained with the 200-epoch schedule, which fails the gate; a converged control (4000 epochs) was therefore run for S1 and is reported in control_schedule_length.json
